baseline.adaptation: Only import URLs are redirected: historical phase module as data URL, unchanged current device profiles as file URL.

method: Timing mode: balanced four-label trials; oldA/oldB identical raw CPU bytes, newA/newB identical optimized bytes; one unchanged native Module. Fresh CPU Modules/instances and equal warmups; construction, optimization and snapshots excluded from execution timing. Validation mode: one raw and one optimized run; no speed inference. Exact PCM, full architectural/diagnostic state and pins checked after every audio block or direct run. Ratios above1 favor optimized CPU. Generation/optimizer-process times and validation-warmed compilation observations are separate single observations, not cold-start medians or browser guarantees.
